description:
AI-powered next-generation cross-platform multithreaded downloader.

A cross-platform fluent-design AI-boost multi-threaded downloader built with Python.
Tip
Join the Ghost Downloader community on Discord: discord.gg/fKfhkPumEM
New Features 🎉
- The Windows installer now supports Japanese, Russian, Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese (#723) By @XiaoYouChR
Improvements 🔧
- Improved feature pack badge styling in the management dialog (#785) By @i0ntempest
- Updated translations (#807, #808) By @i0ntempest
Bug Fixes 🐛
- Fixed the request header editor having inconsistent row heights (#782) By @i0ntempest
- Fixed macOS delta updates invalidating the code signature By @XiaoYouChR
GD4B Browser Extension Updates 🌐
- v2.2.0
- HLS master playlist detection with DRM key bridging for encrypted streams (#800) By @XiaoYouChR
- The extension no longer opens the main window when waking the desktop app (#798) By @XiaoYouChR
- Faster reconnection to the desktop app (timeout and retry interval reduced) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed prefetched video URLs being attributed to the wrong video By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed feed videos losing URL attribution after prefetch elements are destroyed By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed 403 errors on sites where URLs contain fragments (#775) By @XiaoYouChR
Feature Pack Updates 📦
> The following updates may have already been delivered via automatic pack updates.
- ed2k_pack 1.2.0 — ED2K downloads now enter a sharing phase after completion, showing upload rate and sharing duration By @XiaoYouChR

新增功能 🎉
- Windows 安装程序新增日语、俄语、西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语支持 (#723) By @XiaoYouChR
功能优化 🔧
- 优化功能包管理对话框中的徽章样式 (#785) By @i0ntempest
- 更新翻译 (#807, #808) By @i0ntempest
问题修复 🐛
- 修复请求头编辑器行高不一致的问题 (#782) By @i0ntempest
- 修复 macOS 增量更新后签名失效的问题 By @XiaoYouChR
GD4B 浏览器扩展更新 🌐
- v2.2.0
- 支持 HLS 主播放列表检测和 DRM 密钥桥接 (#800) By @XiaoYouChR
- 扩展主动唤醒桌面端时不再弹出窗口 (#798) By @XiaoYouChR
- 加快与桌面端的重连速度 By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复预加载的视频 URL 归属到错误视频的问题 By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复信息流中视频预加载元素销毁后 URL 归属丢失的问题 By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复 URL 包含片段标识符的站点下载 403 的问题 (#775) By @XiaoYouChR
功能包更新 📦
> 以下更新可能已通过自动更新提前推送。
- ed2k_pack 1.2.0 — ED2K 下载完成后进入分享阶段，显示上传速度和分享时长 By @XiaoYouChR
